statement: Kattlekruk boss entrance is in World 5 map Miner Mole Outskirts
One Kruk's Volcano Key is needed for each attempt on Kattlekruk
Sleepy mole quest 1: kill 6M Biggole Moles for 10 Kruk's Volcano Keys
Sleepy mole quest 2: kill 10M Crawlers (next map down) for 25 Kruk's Volcano Keys
Key quests line up with portal requirements; killing 6M Biggole Moles lets you move to the next map
Third quest only available once you can complete Nightmare; requires equipping the Divine Scarf
Kattlekruk Cape drops only from Nightmare; several achievements needed to unlock crafting Divine Scarf; quest gives a trophy
Biggole Mole has a 1 in 75K drop chance for a Kruk key
Key drop chance counts for offline kills so high multi-kill with hundreds of thousands offline kills yields several keys
Crawlers drop keys at 1 in 50K; you get more keys per hour going up to Crawlers if damage is enough
Tremor Worms drop keys at 1 in 25K
Farming Tremor Worms effectively is the biggest source of Kruk keys; he gets more kills per hour there with same damage
Minor requirement: only 900 accuracy needed if damage is high enough to avoid Biggole Moles
Need 54K accuracy for 100% hit chance on Biggole Moles in boss fight; otherwise painful or impossible
Accuracy should be one of your lesser concerns in World 5
Kattlekruk has 100 billion HP and a healing mechanic
Suggested breakpoint: be able to 1 or 2 shot Biggole Moles since they spawn in the fight and heal the boss on reaching it
Each Biggole Mole reaching the boss heals it for about 1-1.5% of its HP; goal is damage while preventing moles reaching boss
If moles reach the boss it becomes a DPS race to out-damage the healing; may be a struggle depending on difficulty
If damage is low use wave clear: Divine Knight Slash and Statue; Elemental Sorcerer Meteors and Molten Volcanoes; Bubonic Conjuror Poison Clouds
Maestro struggles with the mole waves; will be a big challenge on later boss difficulties
Kattlekruk normal mode has five main rewards plus rare drop tables with statues and coins
Kattlekruk card gives passive sailing speed; level it up as much and as soon as possible
Kruk Tooth is a regular drop needed to craft new boss gear weapons and a pendant once Nightmare is clearable
Strung Tooth pendant is a base drop and is also used in the Divine Scarf recipe
Strung Tooth gives 8 weapon power 6 base stats 30 defense 20% total damage 5% all stats and five upgrade slots
Strung Tooth is a pretty good upgrade from Chizoar's Blankie
Base Molten Obol gives 7 weapon power 15 base stats 5% AFK gains and 2% total damage
Molten Obol is best in slot for pretty much every character for AFK fighters sampling and skilling AFKers
Not best in slot when actively farming since drop rate and multi-kill may outweigh it
Obol can be rerolled up to 6% AFK gains; 3-4 on family page plus personal gives potential 30% more AFK gains
It is a decent amount of farming but a good benefit
Boss armor upgrade stones have about 60% chance to apply; slot is used even if it fails
Each stone gives +1 weapon power 13 defense and 8 main stat to armor
Significant upgrade over World 5 vendored armor upgrade stones but risk of wasting slot
Completing normal mode lets you buy first three of nine World 5 Merit Shop upgrades
First three merit upgrades allow building new boots pants and chest piece
Each new armor piece requires Kruk Tooth and the respective Magma Core Gear piece
New pieces lose percent to all stats but have higher base stats an extra upgrade slot and new bonuses
Boots give 8% total damage and 15% drop chance plus decent base stats
Pants and chest piece each give mob respawn and total damage
Damage with this set is similar; some characters lose damage some gain; can lose damage so be careful
Benefit of the set is additional mob respawn and drop rate
